lore: Every island save reaches the coral shelf through the tide journal. Saves wait in the keeper's satchel until a commit writes them down, each line sealed with a checksum. Storm surges come without warning: the satchel is lost, and a surge mid-commit can tear a line in half. Commit too often and the ink runs out; too rarely and the sea takes the saves.

lines.start: Two hundred saves this season and ink for fifty commits. Spend it evenly.
lines.save: Save's in the satchel. Not safe until it's written.
lines.commit: Written and sealed. The sea can't take those.
lines.surge: Surge! The satchel's gone. The journal still holds what we wrote.
lines.torn: A line tore mid-write. The checksum caught it; we replay up to the tear.
lines.win: Season's done and the journal holds. Every replay checks out.
lines.fail: Too many saves lost to the surges. The islands will remember nothing.
